extracted.intended_audience: orthodontic researchers, clinicians, and systematic review authors (dentistry/medicine researchers interested in Class II malocclusion interventions)
extracted.subtask_description: A preregistered systematic review (OSF) of interceptive clear aligner mandibular advancement for pediatric Class II malocclusion, reported as following PRISMA guidelines and aimed at assessing skeletal, dental, and soft tissue outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adherence to PRISMA guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: “A Systematic Review Following PRISMA Guidelines” — the review is reported as following PRISMA.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Page states the review follows PRISMA but does not include the PRISMA checklist or item-by-item reporting on this page. Implied expectations: transparent reporting of protocol, search strategy, study selection (flow diagram), risk of bias assessment, and synthesis methods.

rubrics_metrics.name: OSF preregistration / protocol transparency
rubrics_metrics.description: Osf_registration_schema: OSF Preregistration; Osf_registration_doi: 10.17605/OSF.IO/2M3KG — the review is registered on the Open Science Framework.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presence of an OSF preregistration implies a pre-specified protocol, eligibility criteria, outcomes, and methods; the page itself is a repository record and does not show the full protocol text here.

rubrics_metrics.name: Target population specification
rubrics_metrics.description: Focus on pediatric patients with Class II malocclusion (the population to be studied).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines the demographic/clinical population that studies must address for inclusion; page does not list age cutoffs or detailed inclusion/exclusion criteria on this record.

rubrics_metrics.name: Intervention specification: clear aligner mandibular advancement
rubrics_metrics.description: The intervention under study is interceptive treatment using clear aligner mandibular advancement (aligner mandibular advancement as a modern alternative to conventional functional appliances).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies the treatment modality of interest; the page does not provide detailed device specifications, treatment protocols, or appliance brands on this record.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comparative context: relation to conventional functional appliances
rubrics_metrics.description: Acknowledges that conventional functional appliances have been widely used and positions aligner mandibular advancement as an alternative to be evaluated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implies comparative effectiveness (aligner vs conventional appliances) is a relevant consideration, though no explicit comparator selection or analysis plan is present on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Outcomes: skeletal outcomes
rubrics_metrics.description: The review focuses on skeletal outcomes when assessing effectiveness of the intervention.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Skeletal changes (e.g., mandibular growth, skeletal relationships) are listed as an outcome domain; page does not define specific skeletal metrics or measurement methods here.

rubrics_metrics.name: Outcomes: dental outcomes
rubrics_metrics.description: The review focuses on dental outcomes as a domain to assess effectiveness.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Dental outcomes (e.g., tooth movements, occlusal relationships) are specified as an outcome domain; specific dental measures and assessment timing are not provided on this record.

rubrics_metrics.name: Outcomes: soft tissue outcomes
rubrics_metrics.description: The review focuses on soft tissue outcomes as a domain to assess effectiveness.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Soft tissue or facial/profile outcomes are included as an outcome domain; the record does not enumerate particular soft tissue measures or scales.
